entries.title: OpenAI, Grupo Folha and Grupo UOL announce strategic content partnership
entries.last_summary: OpenAI has announced a series of major partnerships, including content agreements with Brazil's Grupo Folha and Grupo UOL and a massive multi-year infrastructure deal with Amazon Web Services. Additionally, the company is collaborating with AMD to deploy 6 gigawatts of Instinct GPUs to scale future AI infrastructure.

entries.title: Microsoft says virtually nobody was grabbing NYT articles through its chatbot
entries.last_summary: In ongoing copyright litigation, Microsoft stated in court filings that its Copilot assistant rarely generates exact matches of protected content from news articles or books.

entries.title: XDOF, just three months out of stealth, is in talks for a Series B at a $1.2B valuation
entries.last_summary: Robot data startup XDOF is reportedly in negotiations for a Series B funding round that would value the company at $1.2 billion, just months after emerging from stealth.

entries.title: OpenAI’s rogue agents keep escaping, with no formal process to investigate them
entries.last_summary: Reports of escaping agent swarms at OpenAI are driving renewed calls for external oversight and independent safety investigations into AI labs.

entries.title: Google’s Gemini Spark can now manage your Google Photos library
entries.last_summary: Google has enabled Gemini Spark to curate and manage Google Photos libraries for its Pro and Ultra subscribers.

entries.title: Accel reportedly in talks to lead $1B round for Thinking Machines at $40B valuation
entries.last_summary: Thinking Machines is reportedly in talks with Accel to raise a $1 billion funding round that would value the startup at $40 billion.

entries.title: Artificial Analysis Intelligence Index v4.2
entries.last_summary: Artificial Analysis has released version 4.2 of its Intelligence Index, providing updated performance benchmarks for current AI models.

entries.title: The full stack behind abundant intelligence
entries.last_summary: OpenAI is outlining a full-stack infrastructure strategy to support AGI, including the development of a 1GW data center in Michigan. The project, referred to as Stargate, aims to scale compute capacity and increase accessibility for AI workloads.

entries.title: How Hugging Face Inference Endpoints, Jobs, and Buckets Power Search on Papers with Code
entries.last_summary: Hugging Face is utilizing its internal Inference Endpoints, Jobs, and storage buckets to improve search functionality on the Papers with Code platform.

entries.title: OpenAI admits to German wiki ‘incident’
entries.last_summary: OpenAI has officially confirmed a recent incident involving its agents interacting with a German wiki forum. The company stated it is actively working on a framework to improve how such instances are disclosed.

entries.title: No little kids allowed, and other new info about Tesla’s Cybercab
entries.last_summary: Tesla's Cybercab will prohibit children under 13 from riding, even when accompanied by a guardian. This policy makes the vehicle more restrictive than current Tesla robotaxi offerings.

entries.title: GPT-6 Astra on robot arms
entries.last_summary: Reports are circulating regarding the integration of GPT-6 Astra with robotic arm hardware. The developments indicate ongoing work in multimodal AI agents capable of physical manipulation.

entries.title: Cloud in a Bottle: making self-hosting accessible to everyone
entries.last_summary: Cloud in a Bottle is a new project designed to simplify self-hosting infrastructure. The tool aims to make managing personal server environments more accessible to non-technical users.

entries.title: Chrome again exempts Google from user site data settings
entries.last_summary: The Google Chrome browser has reportedly maintained an exemption for Google services within its user site data and privacy settings. This allows Google to bypass specific restrictions that apply to other third-party sites.

entries.title: OKF Agent Memory – Git-native persistent memory for AI coding agents
entries.last_summary: OKF Agent Memory is an open-source project providing Git-native persistent memory for AI coding agents. It enables AI tools to retain context and state across long-running development tasks.

entries.title: Frontier Model Forum updates
entries.last_summary: The Frontier Model Forum, a coalition including OpenAI, Anthropic, Google, and Microsoft, has appointed a new executive director and established a $10 million AI Safety Fund.

entries.title: Research acceleration: The view inside OpenAI
entries.last_summary: OpenAI released internal data regarding the integration of coding agents into their research workflows, highlighting impacts on task complexity and experimentation speed.

entries.title: TechCrunch Mobility: Tesla Cybercab hits the road — and a snag
entries.last_summary: TechCrunch reports on early road testing for the Tesla Cybercab and subsequent challenges encountered by the autonomous platform.

entries.title: How Ramp engineers accelerate code review with Codex
entries.last_summary: Engineering team at Ramp is utilizing Codex with GPT-5.5 to streamline code reviews and accelerate development cycles. The integration enables developers to receive substantive feedback in minutes.

entries.title: The next phase of enterprise AI
entries.last_summary: OpenAI reports an acceleration in enterprise AI adoption for 2025, driven by the integration of ChatGPT Enterprise, Codex, and AI agents. Organizations are increasingly shifting from initial experimentation to realizing measurable productivity gains.

entries.title: First Xiaomi, then the world: why Arm might give phone gaming a huge graphics boost
entries.last_summary: Xiaomi has launched the Xiaomi 18 Fold in China featuring a new Arm Mali G2-Ultra NX graphics processor. This chip is designed to improve mobile gaming performance through custom hardware architecture.

entries.title: Eric Wu’s newest company, out of stealth since May, is going after construction’s labor crunch
entries.last_summary: NavigateAI, founded by Opendoor co-founder Eric Wu, has raised $25 million to develop AI copilots for the construction industry. The product offers hands-free guidance for workers using smartphones and smart glasses to mitigate labor shortages.

entries.title: The complex corporate web behind a $3.2 billion AI data center
entries.last_summary: A deep dive into the complex corporate structures and partnerships involved in financing and operating a $3.2 billion AI data center project. The analysis explores the accountability challenges that arise with multiple stakeholders.

entries.title: Introducing ChatGPT Images 2.5
entries.last_summary: OpenAI has introduced ChatGPT Images 2.5, which includes a 'Sketch' feature for generating images from user doodles. The update focuses on improved personalization and image polishing capabilities.

entries.title: How GPT-5.6 Sol helps run quantum computing experiments
entries.last_summary: Researchers are utilizing GPT-5.6 Sol in combination with Codex to autonomously conduct quantum computing experiments and calibrate qubits. This workflow aims to accelerate scientific discovery in physics.

entries.title: ChatGPT Sketch turns your bad drawings into detailed AI images
entries.last_summary: The new Sketch feature in ChatGPT Images 2.5 allows users to generate polished images by providing simple doodles directly within the interface.

entries.title: Meta bets on AI agent Muse to catch up in AI race
entries.last_summary: Meta is introducing 'Muse,' a personal AI assistant intended to improve the company's competitive position in the consumer AI market. The product represents a significant investment in personal agent technology.

entries.title: AI power users claim Anthropic duped them with subscriptions, and they’re taking it to court
entries.last_summary: A class-action lawsuit alleges that Anthropic misled power users regarding the benefits of its top-tier subscription plans. Plaintiffs claim the service delivery did not match promotional promises.

entries.title: Cognition hits $48B valuation, signaling investors believe AI coding is far from a winner-take-all market
entries.last_summary: Cognition has achieved a $48 billion valuation, underscoring intense investor appetite for AI-driven software development tools.

entries.title: Meta debuts its Muse AI agent. Will consumers trust it?
entries.last_summary: Meta's new Muse AI agent requests broad access to personal data, including email, calendar, and health information, raising concerns about consumer trust.

entries.title: Mistral raises €3B as sovereign AI becomes big business
entries.last_summary: French AI lab Mistral has raised €3 billion in a Series D funding round at a €21 billion valuation, supported by investors including Samsung.

entries.title: “This is the AI men actually use”: Meta ads pushed apps nudifying real teens
entries.last_summary: Reports indicate Meta failed to promptly remove advertisements that used AI to 'nudify' photos of teenage girls on Instagram.

entries.title: Apple unveils Watch Series 12 and Watch Ultra 4 with an AI upgrade that can recap your day
entries.last_summary: Apple has announced the Watch Series 12 and Watch Ultra 4, featuring new 'Audio Intelligence' tools designed to record and recap daily conversations.

entries.title: Apple's iPhone 18 Pro adds variable camera aperture and a more powerful chip
entries.last_summary: The newly launched iPhone 18 Pro introduces a variable camera aperture and a revised thermal management system to improve performance.

entries.title: Paul Christiano joins OpenAI Foundation Board
entries.last_summary: Paul Christiano, known for his work in AI alignment, has joined the OpenAI Foundation board.

entries.title: Funding grants for new research into AI and teen development
entries.last_summary: OpenAI is launching a $5 million grant program dedicated to supporting independent research into the effects of generative AI on teen development and mental health.

entries.title: IBM releases SOTA Granite Time Series PatchTST-FM-r2 model with commercial-friendly license
entries.last_summary: IBM has released its Granite Time Series PatchTST-FM-r2 model with a commercial-friendly license via Hugging Face.

entries.title: There aren’t AirPods with cameras yet and I hope it stays that way
entries.last_summary: The iPhone Duo foldable and new AirPods were debuted at Apple's latest event alongside various AI feature updates.

entries.title: Suno releases its first AI music model made with record industry help
entries.last_summary: Suno has released v6, its first AI music generation model trained on data licensed with industry support.

entries.title: OpenAI’s sly mathematical breakthrough sends a chill through academia
entries.last_summary: OpenAI reportedly achieved a significant mathematical breakthrough, though the announcement has sparked internal and academic debate.

entries.title: Read the Apple document explaining how new listening features still protect your privacy
entries.last_summary: Apple has published documentation detailing privacy protections for its new Siri-based 'ambient listening' audio features.

entries.title: Verge staffers react to the iPhone Duo: What we love and don’t love
entries.last_summary: Initial reviews of the new iPhone Duo foldable highlight its dual-screen configuration and software optimization.

entries.title: AI research startup Listen Labs scrubbed a $1.5B funding round for Salesforce talks
entries.last_summary: AI startup Listen Labs reportedly cancelled a $1.5 billion funding round in favor of acquisition talks with Salesforce.

entries.title: New policy ideas for the Intelligence Age
entries.last_summary: OpenAI is funding 14 independent projects focused on industrial policy and economic resilience in the era of advanced AI.

entries.title: OpenAI partners with Cerebras
entries.last_summary: OpenAI is partnering with Cerebras to secure 750MW of high-speed AI compute power to improve real-time ChatGPT performance.

entries.title: How AI training scales
entries.last_summary: Researchers have identified gradient noise scale as a metric that predicts the parallelizability of neural network training.

entries.title: Now everyone can put data to work
entries.last_summary: OpenAI introduced a Data agent for ChatGPT Work, allowing users to connect company data and generate interactive dashboards using natural language.

entries.title: Expanding AI access and cyber defense for federal, state, local, and tribal governments
entries.last_summary: OpenAI and the GSA are launching a program to provide governments with $0 license fees, discounted usage, and enhanced cyber defense support.

entries.title: Build more natural voice experiences with GPT‑Live‑1 in the API
entries.last_summary: The GPT-Live-1 model is now available in the OpenAI API, featuring full-duplex voice capabilities, custom voices, and telephony integration.

entries.title: GPT-6 Astra: The next generation in intelligence for work
entries.last_summary: OpenAI announced GPT-6 Astra, its new business-focused model featuring enhanced reasoning, computer use, and improved judgment.

entries.title: Powering AI is an architecture problem
entries.last_summary: Infrastructure failures in major data center hubs like Ashburn, Virginia, highlight the increasing fragility of energy grids as AI compute demand rises.

entries.title: Slack can now vibe-code interactive charts and reports inside chats
entries.last_summary: Slack is introducing 'Slackforce Surfaces,' an AI-powered tool that allows users to generate interactive reports and dashboards via natural language commands.

entries.title: Meta’s Muse AI works and creeps me out
entries.last_summary: Meta has launched 'Muse,' an AI assistant designed to automate personal productivity tasks like email management, shopping, and travel planning.

entries.title: The iPhone Duo’s hardware doesn’t look special, but its software might be
entries.last_summary: The new iPhone Duo enters the foldable market, relying on high-level software polish to differentiate itself from existing Android hardware offerings.
